mentions.name: Turingo
mentions.description: This tool detects AI-generated writing based on the writing process rather than the final draft. It tracks unusual changes, including pastes, across the full revision history, giving teachers a clearer picture of how much AI text is present at any time so they can discuss it with a student before jumping to accusations.
mentions.problem: Teachers can't reliably judge how much AI text is in a student's submission from the final draft alone, which leads to jumping to accusations without context.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Turingo: https://turingo.net

The idea is to help them have a conversation with a student before jumping to accusations.
